purpose: Teach: そぐわない/優劣/ケープ/コロニー/歌人/死人/ビジネスチャンス/スンニ

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、治療法が患者様の生活にそぐわない場合、医療チームで再検討します
lines.en: Ren, if a treatment plan doesn't fit well with a patient's life, we'll review it as a medical team.
lines.style: Clear, measured delivery. Even tone without condescension. Steady eye contact. Professional but human — the reassurance of competence.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、医師の優劣を付けない様、医療チームで配慮します
lines.en: Ren, we take care not to rank doctors against each other — we approach it as a team.
lines.style: Slightly softer. A small pause before the explanation, like she's setting context gently. Steady, no defensiveness. The confidence of someone stating obvious principle.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、南アフリカのケープタウン医学会と医療チームで交流します
lines.en: Ren, we exchange knowledge with the Cape Town Medical Society as part of our team's practice.
lines.style: Factual, almost matter-of-fact. A light lift on the name. No grandstanding. Practical, like describing routine collaboration.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、医療従事者の海外コロニー、つまり研究拠点を医療チームで設立します
lines.en: Ren, we're considering establishing a research hub — a base for medical professionals working internationally — as a team initiative.
lines.style: Slower pace on the explanation. Clarifying parenthetically, like she's thinking aloud with him. Not rushed. Thoughtful about scope.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、歌人の患者様への詩的ケアを医療チームでおこないます
lines.en: Ren, we provide poetic, compassionate care for patients who are poets or artists — it's part of our team approach.
lines.style: Warmth enters here, subtle. A quieter delivery. Slight softness on 'poetic' — she means it. Still clear, but touched with something genuine.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、死人、つまりお亡くなりになった患者様のご家族のグリーフケアを医療チームでおこないます
lines.en: Ren, we provide grief care for the families of patients we've lost — our team handles this with real care.
lines.style: Noticeably quieter. Slower, more weighted. A breath before 'lost.' Steady but tender. This is serious ground. No performance, just presence.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、医療事業のビジネスチャンスを医療チームで慎重に検討します
lines.en: Ren, we carefully consider business opportunities in healthcare — we're thoughtful about how we approach them as a team.
lines.style: Returns to measured, professional tone. A slight caution on 'carefully consider' — not cynical, but aware. Steady conviction without harshness.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、スンニ派、つまりスンニ系患者様への宗教的配慮を医療チームでおこないます
lines.en: Ren, we make sure to honor the religious needs of our Sunni Muslim patients — our team is attentive to that.
lines.style: Even, respectful. The clarification lands naturally, not like a translation. Warm but not overwarm. Closing softly, a quiet full stop. The comfort of things being thought through.
